learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected settles at food limit for growth 0.5 and four-year delayed feedback; locked it in. Initial locked graph instead showed one-year delay settling.
observations.exploration: Delay four at growth 0.5 produced repeated swings, late-period maximum 2.9 times limit and minimum 0.07. Slower growth 0.2 with same delay settled, high and low near one. Reveal unlocked after both settings.
observations.reveal: Corrected repeated swings for original case. Cites tested 2.9/0.07 and slower-growth stability. Explains reacting to old food causes overshoot, threshold growth times delay about 1.6, contrasting products two and 0.8.
observations.visual: Inline initial and four-year fast-growth screenshots inspected. Green curve repeatedly crosses dashed limit over 60 years, peaks near three, with labelled late-period extrema. Controls legible. Trust count 5/5 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884151 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.

prediction.reason: Concrete delay/growth setup and distinct long-run outcomes make clear commitment.

interaction.reason: Controlled delay and growth contrasts reveal stability depends on their combination.
interaction.evidence: One-year fast stable, four-year fast swings, four-year slow stable.

payoff.reason: Connects exact observed extrema to lag and product threshold.

clarity.reason: Graph, limit line and late-period extrema make tested behavior legible.
clarity.evidence: Inspected oscillation screenshot and slower-state readout.

transfer.reason: Reusable delay-times-growth principle offered without concrete new feedback system application.
transfer.evidence: Product threshold about 1.6 in this toy model.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard, focus, contrast audit, phone, zoom/reflow and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: Settling prediction reversed by large swings, then restored by slower growth at same delay.

visualExplanation.reason: Time curve carries overshoot and persistent-oscillation mechanism.

playfulness.reason: Delay slider and growth presets support reversible stability exploration.

depth.reason: Lag, growth speed, extrema and stability threshold linked.

complexity.reason: Tracks delayed population feedback, nonlinear trajectories and product threshold.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: moderate: growth rates, years, multiples and product

whyCool: Keeping the same four-year delay but slowing growth turns enormous repeated crashes into a population that settles near its food limit.
caveat: Only two growth rates and delays one/four tested; threshold not probed directly.
